headline: How Counter-Strike began
title: How Counter-Strike Began | From Half-Life Mod to de_dust2 | Classic Games
video_script: Counter-Strike started in nineteen ninety nine as a mod for Half-Life, made by Minh Le and Jess Cliffe. Valve later bought it. Counter-Strike one point six was the most played game in Indian cyber cafes, and de_dust2 is its most famous map. Were you on the T side or the CT side? Comment below!
